  PROBLEM: The plan promises that non-claude/* heads have no extra API call and are unaffected, but the refreshes run before determining whether the head is claude/*.
  WHY: A transient pulls/{n} read failure, or a response without a head SHA/ref, prevents an otherwise eligible non-Claude PR from merging in that cycle and withholds deterministic-skip merge authorization; this contradicts the plan’s non-Claude guarantee at docs/completed/issue-5564-hold-gate-ready-labels-and-poller-merge-plan.md:22.

  PROBLEM: When the refreshed PR ref triggered the gate after a rename, the refusal warning still prints snapshot PR_HEAD_REF, which can identify the old branch name and mislead diagnosis.
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: Report ready_label_current_head_ref when available, falling back to PR_HEAD_REF.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, Location: Line 1969 (merge_hold_gate_allows function) | severity not stated; confidence not stated
  PROBLEM: The warning message logs ${PR_HEAD_REF} from the job environment snapshot, which can be stale if the branch was renamed to claude/* after the gate job ran.
  WHY: The function has access to the refreshed ref via deterministic_skip_pr_json but does not use it in the diagnostic. Suggested minimal fix: Pass the refreshed ref as a parameter to merge_hold_gate_allows() and use it in the warning: `echo "::warning::${gate_refused_what} on PR #${PR_NUMBER} (head ref '${gate_current_ref:-${PR_HEAD_REF}}'): ..."`
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
